_readme: [QixiQingqiu2023 2026-10-15] Jade Hill (Global Qixi 2023) config, read by Base\QixiQingqiu2023\QixiQingqiu2023Ui.cs (re-read when the file changes). OFFICIAL = client data (Questinfo 5561-5567, Server_Key tQingQiuMainNpc / tQiXiPart2 / tQiXiPlay5 / tMassifDraw, luaui dlgchinesesaintvalentinesday, itemtype). DERIVED = chosen here (the number is server-side only).
_memoryCost: DERIVED Clue Bells per memory (the window shows 'X%s Open'; the official count is server-side only).
_memoryAwards: OFFICIAL Questinfo Prize of 5561-5567 (shown under each memory; paid by the quest engine at the finish).
_jadeHill: Peachland Life / memory 'enter' teleport: next to Dale Lord (Questinfo 151,161). OFFICIAL message tQingQiuMainNpc[Msg][Map].

peachland._reward: OFFICIAL tQiXiPart2_DelText[31811][Text815-817]: each daily quest = 1 Clue Bell + 5 Marital Sticks, 3 quests a day.
peachland._minions: DERIVED: underlings to defeat before the boss counts (official text 'Defeat %s to bring out %s'); the day's pair rotates by day of year.

foxTie._dice: OFFICIAL: 38 cells (DlgQingqiuActivityMatchUi), you start on cell 1 and the destined lover on cell 38, 1 Marital Stick per throw (the client test data shows cost 1). DERIVED: dice 1-6.
foxTie._tieReward: OFFICIAL tQiXiPlay5_DelText[Mail][Content][1]: forming a tie gives 3 Marital Fruits.
foxTie._cellRewards: DERIVED: the 38 cell prizes are server-side only. Items are ones the event shows (Fox Practice preview tEight_ShowReward, the Abiding Yearning Scrap the board highlights, Marital Stick); cellChance = % of cells that carry a prize; amounts kept small.

foxPractice._progress: DERIVED: per-mille of the Inner Demon bar per Marital Fruit (50 fruits load the doom). OFFICIAL: a failed crossing takes back 5% (luaUiRes[1403].rules point 5).
foxPractice._points: DERIVED Jade Hill Points per fruit (score bar 0-77777 in the window).
foxPractice._crossChance: DERIVED success % of overcoming the doom (official: 'might fail'; the Inner Demon fight itself is an instance the client has no map for).
foxPractice._pools: ITEMS + AMOUNTS OFFICIAL dlgfoxspiritdrawui tEight_ShowReward / tNine_ShowReward. WEIGHTS DERIVED; the nine-tail pool doubles the scrap weights (official eighttip 'the chance of getting garment scraps will double').
